# Patient Injury - Younker Hyde Macfarlane, PLLC

> A specialized personal injury and medical malpractice law firm in Salt Lake City, Utah, representing clients in cases involving medical negligence, surgical errors, wrongful death, and other injury claims.

Younker Hyde Macfarlane, PLLC is a Salt Lake City-based law firm with deep expertise in medical malpractice litigation and personal injury representation. The firm combines experienced partners with emerging legal talent to serve Utah clients seeking justice for medical negligence, defective products, and serious injuries.
